topic: Deleting a File on Your Computer Does Not Actually Erase It
caption:
🧠 DID YOU KNOW? 🤯

Did You Know Deleted Files Aren't Actually Gone? 🗑️

💡 Emptying the trash only deletes the pointer in the directory index. The actual bytes remain on your hard drive until overwritten, allowing data recovery.
